defects.description: Nullability mismatch: schema allows phone to be NULL, but the TypeScript User interface declares phone as required (non-nullable) -- a row with no phone violates the type at runtime with no error.
`listActiveUsers` does not filter on `deleted_at IS NULL` -- despite its name, it returns soft-deleted users too.

No UNIQUE constraint on email, and signup does a check-then-insert (SELECT then INSERT) with no transaction/lock -- two concurrent signups with the same email can both pass the check and both insert, creating duplicate accounts.
